title: Line Growth Credited for the Time a Signed HECM Plan Change Request Waited
content:
**Clause.** Added to the processing credit of the payment release on a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan moving onto the HECM Line of Credit, Cedarline credits line growth on the standard value for the time the signed change request waited, at the annual rate applied by the most recent line growth posted on the loan (0 when none has posted).

- **Month count.** When the whole calendar months from the request date of the submitted change request onto the HECM Line of Credit to the handling date are at least one (whole calendar months between two dates are complete on the later month's day with the same day number as the earlier date, or on the first day of the following month when that month has no such day number), the processing credit is the standard value multiplied by one twelfth of that rate, divided by 100, multiplied by those months.
- **Day count.** Otherwise, when the calendar days from that request date to the handling date are at least 7, it is the standard value multiplied by that rate, divided by 100, multiplied by those days divided by 365.
- **Otherwise** it is 0.00.

The standard value is the value of the remaining payments with the remaining payments counted as twelve times the difference between the tenure age horizon and the borrower's age on a tenure-based plan, and as the term less the scheduled payments already disbursed on a term-based plan.

**Hypothetical cases (standard value 33576.31, most recent growth rate 6.000 percent).**

| Request dated | Handling date | Whole months / days | Processing credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 10 May | 2 months | 33576.31 multiplied by 0.5, divided by 100, by 2: about 335.76 |
| 10 March | 30 March | 0 months, 20 days | 33576.31 multiplied by 6.000, divided by 100, by 20 divided by 365: about 110.39 |
| 10 March | 17 March | 0 months, 7 days | day count applies |
| 10 March | 16 March | 0 months, 6 days | 0.00 |
| 31 January | 1 March | 1 month (February has no 31st, so the month completes on 1 March) | month count applies |
| any | any, no growth ever posted | any | 0.00 |
